messages.content: "請問你能幫我做幾個計算嗎？首先，我有一個半徑為5.6英呎的圓，我需要知道它的面積。其次，我正在做一個項目，需要繪製一個正弦波。我感興趣的範圍是從0到3.14弧度。波的頻率應該是2赫茲。此外，我希望波的振幅為1.5，相位差為0.5弧度。你能幫我計算面積並繪製正弦波嗎？"

function.name: plot_sine_wave
function.description: Plot a sine wave for a given frequency in a given range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_range.description: Start of the range in radians.

end_range.description: End of the range in radians. This is a float type value.

frequency.description: Frequency of the sine wave in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the sine wave. Default is 1. This is a float type value.

phase_shift.description: Phase shift of the sine wave in radians. Default is 0. This is a float type value.

function.name: geometry_area_circle
function.description: Calculate the area of a circle given the radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circle. This is a float type value.

units.description: The units in which the radius is measured (defaults to meters).
